title: The Tal'mahe'Ra Behind the Hand
summary: The death-cult of mages that stands behind the Black Hand.

claims.text: The Tal'mahe'Ra traded with Kindred for the secrets of vampirism, giving victims, havens, weapons and ghouls for little in return, and in time admitted vampires.
Its mages were surprised that Kindred knew even less about death than they did.
Over centuries the cult studied vampirism through dissection, torture and magickal analysis.
Betrayal of its secrets is punished more harshly than anything the Sabbat or the archons do.

title: The Hand and Honorable Accord
summary: Where the Sabbat Path of Honorable Accord came from.

claims.text: The Black Hand gave the Path of Honorable Accord to the Sabbat.
Most Hand members do not follow it, believing it gets in the way of their true loyalties.

title: Andeleon and the Vicissitude Plague
summary: How Vicissitude is said to have spread through the Tzimisce like a disease.

claims.text: Andeleon spread the disease of Vicissitude among the Tzimisce, and some claim even the torpid Antediluvian was not safe.
Only a few elders hid in their castles out of reach of their clanmates.
Some say the Black Hand bears part of the blame for the Inquisition.

title: The Sabbat Hand and the False Hand
summary: The branches of the Black Hand and its pawns.

claims.text: The Black Hand inside the Sabbat is more active and less conservative than the Camarilla Black Hand, and keeps rituals from Camarilla and Eastern members.
Its seraphim welcome Gehenna and are building an army for that night.
They already command the largest organized body of pawns, the False Hand.

title: The Black Citadel of Enoch
summary: The Underworld stronghold of the Tal'mahe'Ra.

claims.text: Much of the holding lies behind walls of black marble 10 feet thick and 100 feet high, with a bronze gate believed to bear the seal of Caine.
The walls were rebuilt after the city was retaken, to keep out Oblivion-driven monsters, and slave wraiths guard them.
Inside stands a re-created First City, at best a reflection of the original.

title: Chatterlings
summary: Mortals raised in the Underworld to serve the Hand.

claims.text: Chatterlings are mortals raised from early childhood in the Underworld and trained to surpass ordinary humans in body and mind.
They often fail to understand the living world but are very dangerous and almost all are fanatical.
